data.one_liner: Converts JSON maps to YAML strings with beautification and pubspec conventions.
data.what_it_does: json2yaml turns a Dart Map into a YAML string. It handles nested structures, automatically beautifies the output, and supports pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock formatting styles.
use_when: Need to generate YAML from JSON data in a Dart project
Creating or updating pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock files programmatically
Debugging or inspecting JSON structures in YAML format
avoid_when: Performance critical code where string conversion overhead matters
When advanced YAML features (anchors, tags, custom types) are required
strengths: Accurate handling of nested JSON structures
Dedicated pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock formatting styles
weaknesses: No word wrapping for long strings
Limited formatting options beyond the three styles

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full YAML parsing and serialization capabilities, suitable if you need more control over YAML output or need to read YAML back into Dart

alternatives.name: pubspec_parse
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can parse pubspec.yaml files but does not provide JSON to YAML conversion
